_title: Roll or Dare: Party Board Game – Dice, Dares & Monsters (YerseYap)
_description: Roll or Dare (YerseYap) is a party board game for 2–10 players on one phone. Roll the dice, do the dare, explore Adventure Island, dodge monsters, win mini games and spin the Wheel of Fate. Hundreds of dares in 73 languages.
hero_title:
Roll or Dare: Party Board Game
Roll the Dice, Do the Dare!
hero_lead: YerseYap is back, rebuilt from the ground up as Roll or Dare. Roll the dice, move your token, do the dare on your tile and collect points. Do it and the points are yours; chicken out and your friends will never let you forget it. One phone is enough: 2–10 players take turns.
hero_note: Free on Google Play. Formerly known as YerseYap.
screens_desc: Dice, dares, Adventure Island, monsters, mini games, the Wheel of Fate, duels and the podium.
s_1_t: Roll the Dice, Do the Dare
s_1_d: Your turn: roll the dice and move your token across the colorful tiles. The bouncy cartoon dice even matches your player color.
s_2_d: Land on a tile and get a dare worth its points. Tap Done or Couldn’t Do It, swap it with a joker, or start the timer for timed dares.
s_3_d: A 52-tile winding board with portals, pits, mud traps, golden tiles and monster lairs. Tap View for a bird’s-eye look at the island.
s_4_d: The Dragon burns the leader, the Orc collects taxes, the Ghost scares you backwards. Fall into a monster lair and expect a surprise.
s_5_d: Tap Frenzy, Perfect Timing, Color Memory and Dice Guess: earn extra points with your reflexes and memory.
s_6_d: From +40 to Leader −15, from Roll Again to Joker: spin the wheel and accept your fate.
s_7_d: Challenge a rival, both do the same dare, and let the rest of the table pick the winner. Winner +30, draw +15 each.
s_8_d: Podium, confetti and funny awards when the game ends. Rematch is one tap away. 2–10 players, one phone.
how_desc: Set up in a minute, then pass the phone around the table.
how_1_d: Pick the mode (classic or teams), the board (City or Adventure Island), dare categories and the number of rounds. Toggle extra rules like monsters.
how_2_d: Add 2–10 players, type their names and pick a token from 12 characters. In team mode, split into Red and Blue.
how_3_d: On your turn, roll the dice and do the dare on your tile. Done → the points are yours. Couldn’t do it → your friends will remember.
how_4_d: When the rounds are over, the highest score wins. Podium, awards, player stats and a rematch.
modes_desc: Every match is set up the way your table likes it.
board_1_d: The classic, simple board. Quick to learn, quick to play: perfect for a first game or a short session.
board_2_d: A 52-tile winding island with special tiles: Mini Game, Wheel of Fate, Duel, Everyone, Portal, Pit, Mud, Monster Lair, Golden (2×) and Flower Trap. Lap bonus at the finish arch.
team_d: Red team vs Blue team. Points are pooled, so every dare counts for the whole squad.
cat_2_d: Funny, creative and embarrassing dares for friends.
cat_3_d: Adults only. Pick what fits your crowd in match settings.
feat_title: What’s New in Roll or Dare
feat_desc: The game was rebuilt from scratch. Here is what you get.
f_1_d: +40, +25, +10, −10, Leader −15, Everyone +5, Roll Again or Joker. Spin and accept your fate.
f_2_d: Challenge a rival to the same dare. The other players vote for the winner: +30 to the winner, +15 each on a draw.
f_3_d: The whole table does the same dare at once. Your friends decide who did it best.
f_4_d: Tap Frenzy, Perfect Timing, Color Memory and Dice Guess for extra points.
f_5_d: Swap a dare with a joker, earn double points on golden tiles and grab streak bonuses for dares done in a row.
f_6_d: Write your own dares and add them to the deck. Inside jokes included.
f_7_d: Dares with a time limit get an automatic countdown right on the card.
f_8_d: A victory podium with confetti, funny end-of-game awards and a one-tap rematch.
f_9_d: Player statistics across games and a fresh Daily Dare every day.
f_10_d: Starts in your phone’s language automatically. Change it any time from the main menu.
f_11_d: Cat, penguin, sheep, duck, dog, chicken, Pinky, wizard, ninja, yeti, alien and cactus.
f_12_d: No sign-up, no extra devices. Pass the phone around and play.
mon_desc: Land in a monster lair, or get unlucky on a dare tile, and one of them shows up. Monsters can be turned off in match settings.
m_2_d: Swaps your place with another player.
m_5_d: Scares you backwards on the board.
q_1: How many people can play Roll or Dare?
a_1: 2 to 10 players on a single phone or tablet. Players take turns, so there is no need for extra devices.
q_2: Do I need an internet connection?
a_2: The game is played locally on one phone, but it requires an active internet connection to run, since it is free and supported by ads shown at the end of a match.
q_3: Is it suitable for kids and families?
a_3: Yes, with the Family category. Party and Bold (18+) categories contain dares meant for adults; you choose the categories in match settings before every game.
q_4: Can I add my own dares?
a_4: Yes. Open Your Own Dares from the main menu, write your dares and they join the deck in your next match.
a_5: 73 game languages, including English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese and Korean. The game starts in your phone’s language and you can switch from the main menu.
q_6: How is it different from truth or dare?
a_6: It keeps the dares and adds a board game around them: dice, points, Adventure Island, monsters, mini games, the Wheel of Fate, duels and team mode. Every match has a winner on the podium.
arts_desc: Guides and game ideas around YerseYap (in Turkish).
cta_title: Gather Your Friends and Say It: Roll or Dare!
cta_desc: Birthday, house party, New Year’s Eve, camping, dorm room or family night: Roll or Dare gets the fun started.
